successors.name: First Turkic Khaganate
successors.text: 'the Don-Azov steppe zone ... the Utigurs towards the East': the steppe east of the Don and the Sea of Azov

ledger.x: About 558/559: the Utigurs are named among the Avars' enemies.
576: the Utigurs are in Türk service.

wars.name: Utigur-Kutrigur war
wars.outcome: 'Utigurs led by Sandilch attacked the Kutrigurs who suffered great losses' (Utigurs page, undated); Justinian persuaded Sandilch (Zabergan page); both peoples were left decimated.

wars.name: Avar-Utigur wars
wars.outcome: 'for 20 years to come the Avars, under their Khagan Baian, fought Utigurs and Antes, Gepids and Slavs' (Pohl); the Utigurs 'remained in the Pontic steppe' (Utigurs page).

wars.name: Türk conquest of the Pontic steppe and the Bosporos
wars.outcome: Türks, with an Utigur army under Anagai, attack Bosporos in 576; 'Bosphoros fell to them c.

certainty.note: Steppe polity; no page gives a boundary.
